title: Manager, Marketing Data & Analytics

The Manager, Marketing Data and Analytics owns the business data architecture and metric definitions behind Marketing's numbers, and leads the team that measures Marketing. The individual is expected to be advanced in SQL, to design analytical data models, and to profile, reconcile, and diagnose data directly, so they can specify what engineering builds and verify that the result represents the business correctly. They are equally expected to lead three to four analysts, set the standards those analysts work to, and develop the team's technical capability. Data Engineering and the Snowflake team own ingestion, infrastructure, orchestration, transformation pipelines, and semantic view implementation. This role represents Marketing in the design of the data layer, writes the specifications those teams build against, and is accountable for ensuring the resulting data products correctly represent the business.
What you’ll bring to the role:
Business Data Architecture, Metric Definitions, and Context
Own Marketing's canonical metric definitions and the business logic the governed semantic layer implements, and arbitrate those definitions when marketing, finance, and reporting platforms disagree. Specify the semantic models for the most complex and cross-domain marketing use cases, and validate what the Snowflake team builds against that specification. Own the business data architecture for Marketing, defining the facts, dimensions, grain, relationships, hierarchies, and conformed dimensions that connect marketing, customer, product, transaction, and engagement data. Design analytical models that answer cross-domain questions spanning acquisition, engagement, conversion, certification, membership, renewal, and revenue. Write advanced SQL to profile data, validate sources, reconcile metrics, build reusable datasets, and investigate complex customer and business questions. Determine what unstructured content, such as business documentation, definitions, and prior analyses, must be retrievable alongside structured metrics for natural-language and agent-based analysis, and maintain source-to-metric mappings and lineage. WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Stand up the Bedrock Knowledge Base and OpenSearch Serverless vector collection in the client’s account from infrastructure code, with the embedding model, chunking strategy, and metadata fields the architect specified.

- Build the retrieval API on API Gateway and Lambda per the Integration Blueprint - versioned paths, authentication for the Agent Assist provider, per-client rate limits and usage metrics, structured error responses, and a citation payload with source URL, title, section, and last modified date.

- Enforce entitlement at query time by filtering on permission metadata the ingestion pipeline captures - no restricted passage is ever returned to an unentitled caller.

- Provide the Bedrock retrieve-and-generate reference endpoint used for pilot validation in weeks 7-9.

- Build the quality dashboard - relevance, grounding, and citation scores trended per run; permission test results; freshness lag per source; API latency and error rate; OpenSearch capacity.

- Support the contact center pilot in weeks 7-9 - capture retrieval misses, tune, and re-run the suite before each change ships.

- Write the retrieval and API runbooks including model change, re-embedding, and index rebuild procedures with cost implications.

- Pair with client platform owners in weeks 9-10 and hand over on the transition readiness checklist.

REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

- 4+ years as a software or ML engineer, with at least one RAG or enterprise search system delivered to production and measured with an evaluation suite - not just demos.

- Hands-on with Amazon Bedrock - Knowledge Bases, Retrieve and RetrieveAndGenerate APIs, embedding models - and Amazon OpenSearch Serverless vector search including hybrid queries and metadata filters.

- Python, with experience shipping Lambda-based APIs behind API Gateway including auth, versioning, and throttling.

- Infrastructure-as-code with Terraform or AWS CDK and CI for deployment into a client-owned account.

- Practical understanding of chunking, embedding model selection, reranking, and the trade-offs between relevance, latency, and cost.

- Experience building operational dashboards in CloudWatch or an equivalent tool.
